notes.title: NEW MoCup animations
notes.notes:
High-quality animations are the most important part when creating a game that uses the mechanics of the human body. These are not tanks where only the tower and the wheels turn, here every movement of a leg or arm is a whole story that has a reflection in the whole body. When creating the game SCREECH OF STEEL, we recorded animations of blows in a mockup studio, for this purpose a professional sword master was specially invited, participating in dozens of reconstructed battles. Waving a 13 kg sword for 6 hours is not easy, and even with one hand. The boxing bag was smashed into the trash after 20 minutes, so I had to improvise...

[i]"If the tape didn't help, do you need more tape?"[/i]

The case when it didn't work...

notes.title: Added a new arena - the Arcaneum
notes.notes:
The Arcaneum is a small arena for gladiator fights, which can accommodate no more than 6 players.

[img]https://avatars.mds.yandex.net/get-pdb/5087389/c2798d83-16ca-4ba5-89c2-74aa8199fe9e/s375[/img]
[img]https://avatars.mds.yandex.net/get-pdb/4337596/cbbd0646-4cbe-4ba9-a479-a5965ed1eaab/s1200[/img]
The prototype for creating the location was a reference from the TV series "Spartacus: Blood and Sand". We tried to copy all the elements in as much detail as possible: wooden walls, places for guards, stands, sunshades, etc. The audience will be located as close as possible to the players, which creates a sense of privacy.
The location turned out to be very atmospheric and accurately conveys the emotions of the gladiator fight
